原文: As you probably noticed, the SS units are much larger and as would appear they carry much more punch, in the battle sense.  In this campaign, I gave these Elite SS Divisions a strength of 15.  I started out by giving them a strength of 12, but for the difficulty I have set, this was too low.  I also tried 13, but this was still not enough.  Finally for this campaign, I made them 15 but I may not do this for the next ones I create.  There is another reason I gave them this high a strength value.  From research I discovered that the Waffen SS had machineguns assigned to them down to the squad level, and their weapons platoons at the company level also were loaded with machine guns and mortars.  They also had extensive training in aggression, tactics, and teamwork, while at the same time acquiring high levels of "Esprit De Corps".  They also tended to get priority in new weapons allocation and resupply.  Lastly, these units are what this campaign is all about!

This campaign is about SS units against the Allies, they encounter alot of numerical inferiority in each scenario.
